sn35.152:1.1: Sace vo bhikkhave aññatitthiyā paribbājakā evam puccheyyuṃ ||
sn35.152:1.2: Kim atthi yam āvuso samaṇe Gotame brahmacariyaṃ vussatīti ||
sn35.152:1.3: evam puṭṭhā tumhe bhikkhave tesam aññatitthiyānam paribbājakānam evaṃ vyākareyyātha || || 4
sn35.152:1.4: Dukkhassa kho āvuso yassa pariññāya Bhagavati brahmacariyaṃ vussatīti || || 5
sn35.152:1.5: Sace pana vo bhikkhave aññatitthiyā paribbājakā evam puccheyyuṃ || ||
sn35.152:1.6: Katamam pana tam avuso dukkham yassa pariññāya samaṇe Gotame brahmacariyaṃ vussatīti ||
sn35.152:1.7: evam puṭṭhā tumhe bhikkhave tesam aññatitthiyānam paribbājakānam evam vyākareyyātha || || 6-11
sn35.152:2.14: Yam pidam manosamphassapaccayā uppajjati vedayitaṃ sukhaṃ vā adukkhaṃ vā adukkhamasukhaṃ vā tam pi dukkhaṃ ||
sn35.152:2.18: Evam puṭṭhā tumhe bhikkhave tesam aññatitthiyānam paribbājakānam evaṃ vyākareyyāthāti || || 3
